newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Yield of 182-day Lithuanian T-bills slides.
newsitem.headline: Yield of 182-day Lithuanian T-bills slides.

text.p: Lithuanian Treasury bill yields kept falling at auction on Tuesday, with the average rate on 182-day paper slipping to 9.19 percent from 9.79 percent, the central bank said.
MATURITY AV YIELD LAST TIME MIN/MAX ISSUE BID SOLD
Settlement date for the bills is June 6 and they mature on December 5.
The next auction is on June 9, when 50 million litas of 91-day paper will be sold and on June 10 when 50 million litas of 182-day T-bills will be auctioned.
